name: CalcVR Calculator
summary:
CalcVR is a lightweight, native calculator designed specifically for Meta Quest. It runs as a floating 2D panel in your VR environment — always within reach, never in the way.

Two Modes, One Tap Away
Start in Basic mode for everyday math. Need more power? Tap Scientific to unlock a full suite of advanced functions — and switch back just as easily.

Basic Mode: Addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, percentage calculations, sign toggle, backspace and clear.

Scientific Mode: Trigonometric function
